main_body: A wooden hand-cart (brown bed with two legs/wheels and a handle on the right) carrying three grey pots of flowers. The cart bed is the largest volume.
top_band: No real top band. Column x=15 reads dark rows 10-11 (the pots' base shadow/bed back edge), then a single 1-row lighter edge at row 12 (#885a26, L=98), then a flat brown front rows 13-19 (L=64). The cart bed's top surface is hidden behind the pots.
evidence: The cart bed is a flat brown front panel (rows 13-19) under a 1-row highlight at row 12, with only a dark band above it. No horizontal surface of 3 or more rows is visible. The light tone at the right end near x=27 is a tiny patch, not a top. The pots and flowers are drawn face-on, and the legs are flat vertical shapes. This matches the red 'front elevation: top 1' and 'rim only' cases, so it fails.

style.evidence: Measured facts are at or above both references: 33 colours per tile against 17 and 20, 5x5 flat-fill coverage 6% against 13% and 0%, and 36 distinct colours against 40 and 38. The wood has dark, mid, light and edge steps with plank grain. The flowers and leaves use several greens, reds and yellows. Only 22% of dark edge pixels are neutral, so the outlines mostly lean brown or green rather than being a uniform black line. It would sit acceptably next to the references.
